description: This file defines the IConnectionIssueListener interface in the Orleans.EventSourcing namespace, which is used to monitor connection issues within log-consistent grains by implementing callback methods for connection problems and resolutions.

classes.name: IConnectionIssueListener
classes.description: An interface for monitoring connection issues in log-consistent grains, providing methods to handle connection problems and their resolution.

methods.name: OnConnectionIssue
methods.description: Method called when a connection issue occurs, allowing modification of retry delay.

methods.name: OnConnectionIssueResolved
methods.description: Method called when a previously reported connection issue has been resolved.
